capabilities.justification: Reads exactly the agent's channel keys from descriptors the supervisor opened for it, re-checking the owner-only policy on each descriptor; it opens no path.
Checks that exactly the key descriptors were inherited (the one after the last must be closed) before adopting them.

justification: One agent's broker (D18S P2.6d): holds that agent's channel keys and reaches storage only through the supervisor's callbacks over stdin and stdout.
